# Native BILLSTATUS stage regressions

These are exact official GovInfo BILLSTATUS documents retrieved on 2026-09-28.
`provenance.json` records source URLs, complete-file SHA-256 values, and the
expected bounded reading. No source elements were edited or synthesized.

The cases exercise a failed veto override, an agreed resolution whose timed
passage and undated introduction share a day, and a failed bill-passage vote.
The independent comparison source is unitedstates/congress at
`8184bcb13160da2389dea4c902de67817db681fc`; the actual fixture bytes come from
GovInfo, not the community collector's derived JSON.
